By following this case, we unravel the whole landscape of Cleveland and the USA in the 60s/70s - student protests, social justice movements, anti-war movements, and radical militant groups. We give a context to the bombing, which is symbolic on so many levels - it's an art piece that randomly became a target for political violence that, by being left unrepaired, became a reminder of the complicated history of the 60s/70s. The Thinker is a silent witness to this fascinating decade, looking down from his pedestal, still thinking about our place in the world as humans.

overview: Ulises wakes up in a hospital "with no memory". Now he'll reclaim the life he lost: the ex who keeps to stalking her, the business that was stolen from him, and the house of his dreams; however, not everything is as he remembered it.

title: VIRGIN
overview: 16-year-old Abigail's pregnancy scare gives her a new perspective on the 'Virgin Mary' despite the anger and disillusionment she has for the Catholic Church.

title: The Elephant
overview: A heartfelt drama following Casie, an international student who buries herself in parties to avoid confronting her grief and disconnect from her culture. With a high-stakes presentation on her home traditions, she is determined to excel and she would do it–except an invisible elephant keeps creating chaos in her life and ignoring it only makes it worse.

title: CyranØ
overview: What would happen if generative AI got into your dating app? How would it optimize you to find love? Would it work?

title: Breaking Idol
overview: When Jacob Hoggard is accused of rape, blind devotion collides with truth. Breaking Idol exposes the price of power, the peril of fandom, and the courage it takes to speak out.

title: Tingling
overview: A man watches a soothing ASMR video to help him sleep, but the voice meant to calm him soon reveals a chilling connection to his past.

title: Window Shot
overview: Archival films from 1950s Kenya turn settler home windows into a lens on the Mau Mau uprising, revealing how British and American movies framed anti-colonial resistance as the villains of a Western.

title: Flying Like a Bird
overview: In a remote Tibetan monastery, a young monk’s love for basketball and Michael Jordan sparks viral fame and quiet rebellion as he questions the weight of tradition and expectation

title: I Was 8814
overview: Torn from her parents, marked by a number, Hanna escaped Nazi Germany. Decades later, she returns to the place she fled, finding an unexpected path to healing. Hanna Zack Miley was number 8814.

title: Planet of the Tapes
overview: A Deep Dive into the life of Stephen Zivkovic, the owner of the last DVD rental store in Adelaide.

title: T Bird
overview: A homeless streetfighter breaks up a child trafficking ring

title: Observada
overview: A girl goes up to the rooftop of her building to do her laundry, unaware that her obsessive neighbor wants a new piece for his collection.

title: Hazbin Hotel: Live on Broadway
overview: Hosted by series lead Erika Henningsen, at New York’s historic Majestic Theater, this concert event features performances of the show's hit songs from Seasons One and Two by Erika Henningsen, Blake Roman, Amir Talai, Christian Borle, Jessica Vosk, Jeremy Jordan, and Krystina Alabado, with special appearances by Stephanie Beatriz, Kimiko Glenn, Vivienne Medrano, Sam Haft, and Richard Horvitz.

title: The Christmas Ticket
overview: After inheriting her late grandfather's old winter home one week before Christmas, a young woman discovers that he may have hidden a winning lottery ticket somewhere in the house.

title: That Which Is Heard
overview: Shruti Kothari, a stroke survivor and once in-demand theatre performer, finds her way back on stage for the first time in four years.

title: Small Town Pride
overview: In a remote outback Australian town, a brave queer community rallies to keep their vibrant pride weekend alive. Told through three locals’ stories, this film is a sharp, heartfelt look at resilience, belonging, and hope against the odds.

title: Sila
overview: A busy intersection is where Sila, a Palestinian girl, has staked her claim, selling candy to passing motorists. That’s until Yusuf, also her age, starts cutting in on her business. Unexpectedly, a bond develops between the two.

title: Buona Fortuna
overview: On the Sicilian seaside, a counterfeiter and a pickpocket cross paths.

title: Sinterklaas Procession 2025
overview: Direct report of the arrival of Sinterklaas, this year on the island of Texel

title: Bomba
overview: A young man’s pursuit of fame and stardom takes him through the gritty, bustling streets of Manila, until he learns what the city truly demands.
